intro: One medium tub of cinema popcorn gives about 400 kcal (estimate). Most of the calories come from the oil or butter used for cooking and flavouring.

variants.name: Medium popcorn + medium soft drink combo

diet: Yes, popcorn at the movies once in a while is totally okay. What usually pushes the calories up is the large size, caramel flavour and the soft drink combo. Go for a small size or share one tub. Then just enjoy the movie without feeling guilty.
tips: Share one medium tub with your partner or friend.
Choose salted over caramel or cheese. The difference can be more than 100 kcal.
Switch the soft drink to mineral water or a zero sugar drink.

swap.name: Salted popcorn, small
swap.why: You still get the cinema feel, but save about 150 kcal compared to medium.

faq.a: Yes, popcorn itself is a wholegrain and has fibre. What makes it high in calories is the added oil, butter and sugar.

faq.q: Caramel or salted popcorn, which is better?
faq.a: Salted popcorn is usually lower in calories and sugar. Caramel has a sugar coating that adds a lot of calories.

faq.q: Can I bring my own popcorn to the cinema?
faq.a: Most cinemas don't allow outside food. Easier to pick a small size at the counter, or make your own popcorn when watching a movie at home.
